dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Three prominent irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures in the mid-lateral region exhibit high-contrast perimeters with a sharp gradient transition from dark background pixels to light-toned boundary lines; the edges are characterized by jagged, non-uniform pixel distributions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low spatial density of solid high-intensity pixel clusters, primarily concentrated in a singular grouping at the anterior insertion point of the pectoral flipper and smaller isolated clusters near the dorsal ridge.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most distinct central-lateral annuli define an obtuse scalene triangle with the primary axis aligned longitudinally from the mid-section toward the posterior.

other_distinctive_markers: A dense, interlocking network of light-toned curvilinear lines creates a maze-like texture in the anterior-dorsal region, distinct from the discrete annuli observed elsewhere.
